primary_endpoint: Change in intrahepatic lipid content from baseline to 6 months measured by 1H-MRS.
efficacy_outcome: At 6 months, intrahepatic lipid content changed by -5.2 in the growth hormone group and +3.8 with placebo; no statistical comparison was reported.
safety_signal: Serious adverse events occurred in 1/24 participants receiving growth hormone and 0/25 receiving placebo; there were no deaths in either group.
